name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: O'Hare Precision's only active channel this period is Google Business Profile, which drove 188 total actions (134 directions, 11 calls, 43 web clicks) over 28 days, but GBP engagement dropped 54.35% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely reflecting reduced search demand or a dip in profile visibility. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads, so reactivating paid campaigns should be the immediate priority to generate measurable lead volume.

performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; organic GBP collapsing — revenue pipeline at zero.

findings.text: OVERDUE: 3 CRM milestones unresolved since July 7 — 342 stub accounts still block Sales-i sync, killing pipeline visibility.
OVERDUE: Tom call list flagged priority July 28 and dedup workbook (447 groups, 126 accounts) delivered July 31 — no completion event recorded for either.
Meta and Google Ads spend is $0 for all 28 days; CPL is undefined — zero paid lead volume for the entire period.
GBP actions collapsed to near zero in last 3 days (Aug 28–30: 1, 0, 0) vs prior 3 (Aug 25–27: 8, 0, 1) — down from a 28-day total of 188 actions, 54.35% weekly drop confirmed.
Search Console clicks show 3-day signal of 4, 0 (Aug 29–30) vs prior 3-day avg of ~22 — organic search traffic dropping sharply at month-end.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342 stub account reconciliation immediately — Sales-i sync and pipeline data are fully blocked until resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: The 342 stub accounts have no Customer ID match, which means Sales-i cannot sync any activity data to Sugar for these records — the pipeline is blind on all of them. This is a confirmed blocker flagged since July 7. Ahmed to run name-based match against the authoritative customer sheet and post a reconciliation batch with rollback file to the Monday CRM board. Success check: zero stub accounts remaining with no Customer ID by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Execute approved 447-group dedup merge workbook in audited batches — delivery was confirmed July 31 but no merge completion event recorded.
suggestions.monday_update: The dedup workbook covering 447 duplicate groups (437 standard merges, 2 partial CID merges, 6 do-not-merge, 2 held for Epicor verification) was delivered July 31 but shows no completed merge event. Dev team to execute in audited batches per the approved workbook, posting rollback files to the Monday CRM board after each batch. Success check: all 437 eligible merges executed and rollback files posted by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and SC clicks for 3 more days — if both remain at or near zero, profile visibility issue requires investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 29 and Aug 30, and SC clicks dropped to 4 and 0 on the same days, against a 28-day GBP total of 188 actions and a typical daily SC range of 15–30 clicks. This may be a weekend/month-end pattern rather than a structural visibility drop. Re-check on 2026-09-03: if GBP actions and SC clicks have not recovered to prior weekly averages, escalate to a GBP profile audit and SEO review.
